title: Elimar
promptLanguage: Pin each chapter of a long art story and reveal the opening line as split letters, while a WebGL field holds one figure that stays whole at a distance. Dates and captions stay small under the pictures, and a still frame remains when motion is off.
notes: The public page is a five-chapter reading with a scroll cue on each chapter, spaced letters in the opening lines, and dated picture rows. An inquiry and a long credit list close the page as ordinary text.
reducedMotion: Reduced motion keeps every chapter, caption, and the inquiry in place and shows the figure as a still frame.
